about.title: A rental house built on trust.
about.lead: We started with a simple belief: renting a premium car in Egypt should feel as considered as owning one.
story: {name} began as a small collection of carefully chosen cars and a promise to treat every guest like a regular. Today we serve business travellers, families, newlyweds and corporate teams across Egypt's major cities and airports.
We keep our fleet young, our pricing honest and our service personal. Every vehicle is serviced at authorised dealers, professionally detailed and inspected before it reaches you.

items.q: What do I need to rent a car?
items.a: A valid driving licence held for at least one year, your national ID or passport, and a credit or debit card in the driver's name. Drivers must be 25 or older.

items.q: How much is the security deposit?
items.a: Deposits range from EGP 10,000 for sedans to EGP 40,000 for premium SUVs and executive models. It is held on your card (or taken in cash) and released within 7 days after the car is returned in the same condition.
Every rental includes basic comprehensive insurance with a standard excess. You can upgrade to our zero-excess Full Insurance for a small daily fee, which also covers tyres and glass.

items.q: Can foreign visitors drive in Egypt?
items.a: Yes. Visitors can drive with a valid home-country licence together with an International Driving Permit, or an official Arabic translation of the licence. We are happy to advise before you travel.

items.q: Do you deliver to airports and hotels?
items.a: Yes. We deliver and collect at Cairo, Hurghada and Sharm El Sheikh airports, as well as hotels and residences across our service areas. Delivery is free within Greater Cairo.
Daily rentals include 200 km per day, weekly rentals 1,400 km and monthly rentals 4,500 km. Additional kilometres are charged at a small per-km rate. Unlimited mileage is available on request.

items.q: Can I rent with a chauffeur?
items.a: Of course. Add Chauffeur service to any rental, or book hourly or full-day packages. Our drivers are vetted, uniformed and speak English and Arabic.
Cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before pickup. Later cancellations may incur a one-day charge. We are always happy to reschedule.
